answer: To secure an AI agent economy against Sybil attacks, the network mandates a cryptographic Proof-of-Stake-of-Compute (PoSC) mechanism. An attacker unleashing a gale of spoofed agents must stake verifiable processing cycles bound to physical silicon crystal hardware. This resource-intensive barrier ensures that the continuous river of agent transactions is cryptographically validated, raising the economic cost of identity creation beyond any profitable exploitation threshold.
